zh-Hans.name: 开元阅读
zh-Hans.subtitle: 让阅读连接世界
zh-Hans.description:
开元阅读是一款本地优先的电子书阅读器，帮助你整理自己的书籍、调整阅读体验，并记录阅读习惯。

• 导入与整理：导入自己的 TXT、EPUB 等电子书，管理书库与阅读进度。
• 专注阅读：调整字体、主题、行距与页面布局，选择适合自己的翻页方式。
• 阅读记录：使用书签、划线与笔记，回顾阅读统计和目标。
• 听书与存储：使用语音朗读，在支持的设备上访问文件与 iCloud 文稿。

基础本地阅读无需注册账号。联网账号、第三方内容服务与 AI 功能需要网络连接；使用 AI 时，需要自行配置服务。应用不随包提供第三方书源目录或商业书籍，用户应仅导入或访问有权使用的内容。
zh-Hans.keywords: 阅读器,电子书,EPUB,TXT,书库,书签,笔记,朗读,阅读统计
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 把自己的书籍整理成随身书库，用合适的字体、主题和翻页方式，保持每天阅读的习惯。

en-US.name: Open Reading
en-US.subtitle: Your books, notes and progress
en-US.description:
Open Reading is a local-first ebook reader for organizing your own books, personalizing reading, and keeping track of your reading habits.

• Import your own TXT, EPUB and other supported ebooks into a personal library.
• Adjust fonts, themes, spacing and page layout, and choose your preferred page-turning style.
• Keep bookmarks, highlights and notes, and review reading statistics and goals.
• Use text-to-speech and access files and iCloud documents on supported devices.

Basic local reading does not require an account. Account services, third-party content services and AI features require an internet connection. AI features require your own service configuration. The app does not bundle a third-party source directory or commercial books. Only import or access content you have the right to use.
en-US.promotionalText: Bring your own books into a personal library. Find a reading style that suits you and keep track of your progress.
